note: 대한전선(Taihan Cable & Solution) 케이블 제조 카탈로그 — 호반그룹 자회사. 공장: 안양(R&D, HV/EHV 시험장), 당진(EHV 전력케이블, 해저케이블 수직 압출), 베트남(동조괴, MV/LV 케이블). 핵심 공정: 동조괴 연속주조 → 도체 연신 → XLPE 절연 압출 → 시즈·연합 → 차폐 편조 → 권취·재단 → HV 시험. 외국인 작업자 비중 높음 (베트남 공장 전체, 국내 일부) — 다국어 SOP 필수. 사용자 face label 은 '케이블 제조'. regulation 인용은 산업안전보건기준규칙·KOSHA·KEC·IEC 우선이며 현장 안전관리자 검수 필요.

COPPER_ROD_CASTING.label_th: หล่อต่อเนื่องแท่งทองแดง

baseline.content: 용탕 비산 방지 — 차폐벽·이송로 격리·작업자 안전거리 5m + 비상정지 도달성
baseline.content_en: Molten splash prevention — shield walls, transfer-path isolation, 5m worker clearance, e-stop reachability
baseline.content_vi: Chống bắn kim loại lỏng — tường chắn, cách ly đường vận chuyển, công nhân cách 5m, nút dừng khẩn dễ với
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันการกระเด็นของโลหะหลอม — กำแพงกั้น แยกเส้นทางลำเลียง คนงานห่าง 5 ม. ปุ่มหยุดฉุกเฉินเข้าถึงได้
baseline.content_id: Cegah cipratan logam cair — dinding pelindung, isolasi jalur transfer, jarak pekerja 5m, e-stop terjangkau

scenarios.content: 수분 잔류 도가니에 용탕 주입 시 수증기 폭발
scenarios.content_en: Moisture in crucible causes steam explosion when molten copper is poured
scenarios.content_vi: Ẩm còn trong nồi nấu gây nổ hơi nước khi đổ đồng nóng chảy
scenarios.content_th: ความชื้นในเบ้าหลอมทำให้เกิดระเบิดไอน้ำเมื่อเทโลหะหลอม
scenarios.content_id: Sisa air dalam crucible memicu ledakan uap saat tuang tembaga cair

scenarios.content: 베트남 신규 작업자가 차폐벽 없는 통로 횡단 중 슬래그 비산 화상
scenarios.content_en: New foreign worker crosses unshielded path; slag splash causes burn
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân nước ngoài mới đi qua lối không che chắn; bị bỏng do xỉ bắn
scenarios.content_th: คนงานต่างชาติใหม่ข้ามทางที่ไม่มีกำแพงกั้น โดนสแลกกระเด็นไหม้
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja asing baru lewat tanpa pelindung; terkena cipratan slag

mitigations.content: 용탕 주입 전 도가니 수분 확인(적외선 온도계 ≥150°C 유지) + 책임자 사인
mitigations.content_en: Pre-pour crucible moisture check (IR thermometer ≥150°C) + supervisor sign-off
mitigations.content_vi: Trước khi đổ kiểm tra độ ẩm nồi (IR ≥150°C) + ký xác nhận của giám sát
mitigations.content_th: ก่อนเท ตรวจความชื้นเบ้าหลอม (IR ≥150°C) + ผู้ดูแลเซ็นรับ
mitigations.content_id: Cek kelembapan crucible (IR ≥150°C) + tanda tangan supervisor sebelum tuang

mitigations.content: 출입통제 라인 + 픽토그램 + 신규 작업자 본격 투입 전 1주 OJT (모국어)
mitigations.content_en: Restricted-access line + pictograms + 1-week OJT in mother tongue before solo work
mitigations.content_vi: Vạch cấm + pictogram + 1 tuần OJT bằng tiếng mẹ đẻ trước khi làm độc lập
mitigations.content_th: เส้นจำกัดทาง + พิกโตแกรม + OJT 1 สัปดาห์ภาษาแม่ก่อนทำงานเดี่ยว
mitigations.content_id: Garis pembatas + piktogram + OJT 1 minggu bahasa ibu sebelum kerja mandiri

ppe.content: 알루미늄 코팅 방열복 + 방열장갑 + 안면보호구(face shield) + 안전화(고온 등급)
ppe.content_en: Aluminized heat suit + heat gloves + face shield + high-temp safety boots
ppe.content_vi: Áo chống nhiệt phủ nhôm + găng chống nhiệt + tấm che mặt + giày chịu nhiệt
ppe.content_th: ชุดสะท้อนความร้อนเคลือบอะลูมิเนียม + ถุงมือกันร้อน + กระบังหน้า + รองเท้าทนความร้อน
ppe.content_id: Pakaian tahan panas berlapis aluminium + sarung tangan + face shield + sepatu tahan panas

XLPE_EXTRUSION.label_th: อัดรีดฉนวน XLPE

baseline.content: 가교 가스 누설·고온 폴리머 화상 방지 — LEL <10% 모니터링 + 인터록 + 격리 가드
baseline.content_en: Crosslinking-gas leak / hot-polymer burn prevention — LEL <10% monitoring, interlocks, isolation guards
baseline.content_vi: Phòng ngừa rò khí cross-link / bỏng polymer nóng — đo LEL <10%, khóa liên động, vách cách ly
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันก๊าซ crosslink รั่ว / โพลิเมอร์ร้อน — ตรวจวัด LEL <10% อินเตอร์ล็อก แผงกั้น
baseline.content_id: Cegah bocor gas crosslink & luka bakar polimer — LEL <10%, interlock, sekat isolasi

scenarios.content: 압출기 다이 청소 중 잔류 200°C 폴리머 분출, 작업자 손목·전완 화상
scenarios.content_en: Residual 200°C polymer spurts during die cleaning, burns operator's forearm
scenarios.content_vi: Polymer 200°C còn dư phun ra khi vệ sinh khuôn, bỏng cẳng tay công nhân
scenarios.content_th: โพลิเมอร์ 200°C ตกค้างพุ่งออกขณะทำความสะอาดแม่พิมพ์ ไหม้ปลายแขนคนงาน
scenarios.content_id: Polimer 200°C menyembur saat membersihkan die, membakar lengan operator

scenarios.content: 가교 가스(쿠멘 하이드로퍼옥사이드) 누설로 LEL 25% 도달, 폭발 위험
scenarios.content_en: Crosslinking gas (cumene hydroperoxide) leak reaches 25% LEL — explosion risk
scenarios.content_vi: Rò khí crosslink (cumene hydroperoxide) đạt 25% LEL — nguy cơ nổ
scenarios.content_th: ก๊าซ crosslink (cumene hydroperoxide) รั่วถึง 25% LEL — เสี่ยงระเบิด
scenarios.content_id: Bocor gas crosslink (cumene hydroperoxide) capai 25% LEL — risiko ledakan

mitigations.content: 다이 청소 전 압출 정지 → 압력 해소 → 30분 냉각(<60°C 확인) → 청소
mitigations.content_en: Before die cleaning: stop extruder → release pressure → cool 30 min (<60°C) → clean
mitigations.content_vi: Trước khi vệ sinh khuôn: dừng máy → xả áp → nguội 30 phút (<60°C) → vệ sinh
mitigations.content_th: ก่อนทำความสะอาดแม่พิมพ์: หยุดเครื่อง → ปล่อยแรงดัน → ลดอุณหภูมิ 30 นาที (<60°C) → ทำความสะอาด
mitigations.content_id: Sebelum membersihkan die: hentikan ekstruder → lepas tekanan → dinginkan 30 mnt (<60°C) → bersihkan

mitigations.content: LEL 5% 도달 시 경고, 10% 자동 환기 + 라인 정지 인터록
mitigations.content_vi: LEL 5% cảnh báo, 10% tự thông gió + khóa liên động dừng dây chuyền
mitigations.content_th: LEL 5% เตือน 10% ระบายอากาศอัตโนมัติ + อินเตอร์ล็อกหยุดสายการผลิต
mitigations.content_id: LEL 5% peringatan, 10% ventilasi otomatis + interlock henti jalur

ppe.content: 방열장갑 + 방열 토시 + 보안경 + 방독마스크(유기증기 정화통)
ppe.content_en: Heat gloves + heat sleeves + safety goggles + organic-vapor respirator
ppe.content_vi: Găng chống nhiệt + tay áo chống nhiệt + kính bảo hộ + mặt nạ lọc hơi hữu cơ
ppe.content_th: ถุงมือกันร้อน + ปลอกแขนกันร้อน + แว่นนิรภัย + หน้ากากกรองไอระเหยอินทรีย์
ppe.content_id: Sarung tangan + lengan tahan panas + kacamata + masker filter uap organik

DRUM_WINDING.label_vi: Cuốn cáp & xử lý tang cáp
DRUM_WINDING.label_th: การม้วน·เคลื่อนย้ายดรัมเคเบิล

baseline.content: 권취 협착 방지 — 인터록·라이트커튼·양손 기동 + 권취 중 가드 개방 금지
baseline.content_en: Winder nip-point — interlock, light curtain, two-hand control; no guard removal during operation
baseline.content_vi: Chống kẹp tay khi cuốn — khóa liên động, light curtain, vận hành 2 tay; cấm mở cửa bảo vệ khi đang cuốn
baseline.content_th: ป้องกันจุดบีบ — อินเตอร์ล็อก ม่านแสง ควบคุมสองมือ; ห้ามเปิดการ์ดขณะทำงาน
baseline.content_id: Cegah titik jepit — interlock, light curtain, kontrol dua tangan; jangan buka guard saat operasi

scenarios.content: 라이트커튼 우회·인터록 부정 해제 후 손가락 협착 절단
scenarios.content_en: Operator bypasses light curtain; finger amputation in nip point
scenarios.content_vi: Vô hiệu hóa light curtain → ngón tay bị kẹp đứt
scenarios.content_th: บายพาส light curtain → นิ้วถูกหนีบขาด
scenarios.content_id: Bypass light curtain → jari teramputasi di nip

mitigations.content: 인터록 우회·라이트커튼 부정해제 즉시 무관용 징계 + 매 교대 시작 시 점검 사인
mitigations.content_en: Zero-tolerance discipline for bypass; shift-start interlock test sign-off
mitigations.content_vi: Kỷ luật nghiêm khi vô hiệu hóa khóa; đầu ca kiểm tra & ký
mitigations.content_th: ลงโทษทันทีหากบายพาส; ตรวจสอบและเซ็นต้นกะ
mitigations.content_id: Sanksi tanpa toleransi; cek dan tanda tangan awal shift

ppe.content: 내절단 장갑(Level D ANSI) + 안전화 + 안전모
ppe.content_en: Cut-resistant gloves (ANSI Level D) + safety shoes + hard hat
ppe.content_vi: Găng chống cắt (ANSI Level D) + giày bảo hộ + mũ bảo hộ
ppe.content_th: ถุงมือกันบาด (ANSI Level D) + รองเท้านิรภัย + หมวก
ppe.content_id: Sarung tangan anti-potong (ANSI Level D) + sepatu safety + helm

baseline.content: 드럼(50톤급) 이송·전도 방지 — 양중 줄걸이 검사 + 결박 표준 + 지게차 운반 시 마스트 각도
baseline.content_en: 50-t drum transport & tip-over prevention — sling inspection, securement, forklift mast angle
baseline.content_vi: Vận chuyển & chống lật drum 50 tấn — kiểm tra cáp cẩu, neo, góc cột nâng forklift
baseline.content_th: เคลื่อนย้ายและกันล้ม drum 50 ตัน — ตรวจสาย ผูกรัด มุมเสาฟอร์คลิฟต์
baseline.content_id: Pemindahan & cegah jatuh drum 50t — inspeksi sling, ikat, sudut mast forklift

scenarios.content: 지게차 마스트 과경사로 드럼 전도, 인근 작업자 협착
scenarios.content_en: Excessive forklift mast tilt causes drum tip-over, crushing nearby worker
scenarios.content_vi: Mast forklift nghiêng quá → drum lật, kẹp công nhân gần đó
scenarios.content_th: เสาฟอร์คลิฟต์เอียงเกิน → drum ล้มทับคนงานใกล้เคียง
scenarios.content_id: Mast forklift miring berlebihan → drum jatuh menimpa pekerja

mitigations.content: 지게차 마스트 각도 표시기 + 운반 중 작업자 4m 이내 출입 금지
mitigations.content_en: Forklift mast-angle indicator + 4m worker exclusion zone during transport
mitigations.content_vi: Đồng hồ góc mast + cấm công nhân vào trong 4 m khi vận chuyển
mitigations.content_th: ตัวแสดงมุม mast + คนงานห่าง 4 ม. ขณะขนส่ง
mitigations.content_id: Indikator sudut mast + zona larangan 4m saat pemindahan

ppe.content_en: Hard hat + safety shoes + hi-vis vest + signaller radio
ppe.content_vi: Mũ + giày + áo phản quang + bộ đàm cho người ra hiệu
ppe.content_th: หมวก + รองเท้า + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง + วิทยุผู้ส่งสัญญาณ
ppe.content_id: Helm + sepatu + rompi hi-vis + radio signalman

HV_TEST_LAB.label_vi: Phòng thử HV (PD / chịu điện áp)
HV_TEST_LAB.label_th: ห้องทดสอบ HV (PD / Withstand)

baseline.content: 잔류전하 방전 대기 — 시험전압 250 kV급, 시정수×5 이상 + 검전 + 단락접지 후 출입
baseline.content_en: Residual-charge dwell — at 250 kV+ test, wait ≥5× RC time constant, then verify zero with tester and apply grounding before entry
baseline.content_vi: Chờ phóng điện dư — thử 250 kV+, chờ ≥5× hằng số thời gian RC, đo điện về 0 và tiếp địa trước khi vào
baseline.content_th: รอประจุไฟฟ้าตกค้างคาย — ที่ทดสอบ 250 kV+ รอ ≥5× ค่าคงที่เวลา RC ตรวจวัด 0V และต่อกราวด์ก่อนเข้า
baseline.content_id: Tunggu pelepasan muatan sisa — uji 250 kV+, tunggu ≥5× konstanta waktu RC, verifikasi 0V & grounding sebelum masuk

scenarios.content: 방전 대기시간 미준수 후 잔류전하 인입 → 인입 사망 사고
scenarios.content_en: Operator enters before discharge dwell ends; residual charge causes fatal shock
scenarios.content_vi: Vào phòng trước khi hết thời gian phóng dư; điện áp dư gây tử vong
scenarios.content_th: เข้าก่อนครบเวลาคาย — แรงดันตกค้างถึงตาย
scenarios.content_id: Masuk sebelum waktu discharge selesai → kejut fatal akibat sisa muatan

mitigations.content: 전압 인가 종료 직후 자동 방전 회로 작동 → 타이머(시정수×5) 만료 후 도어 인터록 해제 → 검전기로 0V 확인 → 단락접지봉 부착 → 출입
mitigations.content_en: Auto-discharge after de-energize → door interlock releases only after timer (5× RC) → tester confirms 0 V → ground stick attached → entry
mitigations.content_vi: Tự phóng dư sau cắt điện → khóa cửa chỉ mở sau timer (5× RC) → đo 0 V → móc tiếp địa → vào
mitigations.content_th: ปลดไฟอัตโนมัติคายดิสชาร์จ → ประตูปลดล็อกหลัง timer (5× RC) → วัด 0 V → ใส่ ground stick → เข้า
mitigations.content_id: Auto-discharge setelah de-energize → interlock terbuka setelah timer (5× RC) → tester 0V → ground stick → masuk

mitigations.content: 외국인 시험원 4단계 절차(활선→정전→검전→단락접지) 모국어 SOP + 표준 손짓 신호 통일
mitigations.content_en: Foreign test crew 4-step SOP (energize→de-energize→verify→ground) in mother tongue + standardized hand signs
mitigations.content_vi: SOP 4 bước tiếng mẹ đẻ cho kỹ thuật viên nước ngoài + ký hiệu tay chuẩn
mitigations.content_th: SOP 4 ขั้นภาษาแม่สำหรับเจ้าหน้าที่ต่างชาติ + สัญญาณมือมาตรฐาน
mitigations.content_id: SOP 4 langkah bahasa ibu untuk teknisi asing + isyarat tangan standar

ppe.content: 절연 장갑(Class 4 36 kV) + 절연화 + 아크플래시 PPE(CAT 4, IEEE 1584 계산)
ppe.content_en: Insulating gloves (Class 4 36 kV) + insulating boots + arc-flash PPE (CAT 4 per IEEE 1584)
ppe.content_vi: Găng cách điện (Class 4 36 kV) + giày cách điện + PPE arc-flash (CAT 4 theo IEEE 1584)
ppe.content_th: ถุงมือฉนวน (Class 4 36 kV) + รองเท้าฉนวน + PPE arc-flash (CAT 4 ตาม IEEE 1584)
ppe.content_id: Sarung tangan isolasi (Class 4 36 kV) + sepatu isolasi + PPE arc-flash (CAT 4 per IEEE 1584)
